blacklist.title: Translation Blacklist
blacklist.hint: Specify words that should not be translated, such as brand names, personal names, code variables, etc. These words will be protected during translation.
blacklist.placeholder: Enter word to protect, press Enter to add

hotkeys.title: Hotkey Settings
hotkeys.hint: Customize global hotkeys. Restart app to apply changes.
hotkeys.pageDesc: Click a field and press a combo to record; applies after save. Auto-select/pop button are under Selection.

proxy.title: Proxy Settings
proxy.enableHint: Send translation requests through proxy server

apiServer.title: API Server
apiServer.hint: Enable local HTTP API server to allow external tools to call translation functions. Restart app to apply.
apiServer.enableHint: Provide REST API on local port

postProcess.title: Translation Post-Processing
postProcess.qualityHint: Symbol repair and batch response validation (AiNiee-style)
postProcess.symbolRepairHint: Align dialogue quotes and CJK punctuation with the source
postProcess.responseCheckHint: Warn on empty, identical, newline, or count mismatches in batch results
postProcess.autoCorrectHint: Detect garbled text and likely untranslated output
postProcess.fixPunctuationHint: Fix extra spaces and punctuation placement
postProcess.fixNewlinesHint: Merge extra blank lines, normalize newlines

preProcess.title: Translation Pre-Processing
preProcess.hint: Auto-correct and replace source text before translation (e.g., remove control chars, normalize fullwidth characters)
preProcess.normalizeUnicodeHint: Convert fullwidth characters to halfwidth (e.g., Ａ→A, １→1)
preProcess.removeControlCharsHint: Remove invisible control characters (preserves newlines and tabs)
preProcess.langPairPlaceholder: e.g. ja-zh, leave empty for all
preProcess.pageDesc: Regex replace and clean source text before translation
preProcess.langFilter: Language pair filter (e.g. ja-zh); empty = all

backup.title: Config Backup
backup.hint: Export current config as JSON file, or import config from file.

windowFollow.title: Window Follow
windowFollow.hint: Auto-move main window near mouse when translating

sync.title: Cloud Sync (WebDAV)
sync.description: Sync your configuration, glossary, and translation history across devices via WebDAV.
sync.enableHint: Sync data via WebDAV when enabled
sync.serverUrlHint: WebDAV server address, e.g. Nutstore, NextCloud, etc.
sync.passwordPlaceholder: Enter WebDAV password or app password

offline.title: Offline Translation
offline.hint: Use local models for offline translation without network connection
offline.enableHint: Download and use local translation models

tm.title: Translation Memory Settings
tm.autoSaveHint: Automatically save to translation memory after translation
tm.fuzzyMatchHint: Enable fuzzy matching to find similar translations

nav.aiDesc: API keys, models, and prompts. Enable order is under Engines; learning also uses this model.

basic.title: General
basic.batchDesc: Default engine for BatchManager queue (document translate still uses main engine order unless batch_submit)
basic.batchEngine: Preferred engine ID (empty = main/batch default path)
basic.batchEngineHint: Maps to BatchConfig.engine; must match an enabled engine name.
basic.clipboardMonitorHint: Watch clipboard and translate automatically (Windows event-driven; synced with main clipboard button)
basic.autoCopyHint: Copy translation to clipboard when done
basic.clipboardPasteHint: On: Ctrl+V paste (default, compatible). Off: Unicode key simulation (clipboard unchanged)
basic.ttsAutoHint: Play result with the TTS backend below
basic.ttsDesc: Edge free by default; Fish free model needs key; OpenAI-compatible needs key; Youdao good for words
basic.fishHint: s2.1-pro-free is Fish free tier (fair use, no SLA). Still needs API key; or set FISH_API_KEY.
basic.fishRef: Voice reference_id (Fish voice library / clone model ID)

appearance.themeDesc: Also switchable from the sidebar footer
appearance.lightDesc: Light gray canvas, dark action buttons

ocr.pageDesc: Image → text only. Translation follows engine order; switch engines in the result card.
ocr.relationThisPageDesc: : recognition backends (WinRT / Youdao / offline) and watch interval
ocr.relationEnginesDesc: : text → another language priority and keys
ocr.relationNote: OCR card shows one translation with fallback; no multi-engine side-by-side
ocr.readyHint: {engine} works out of the box; no extra setup.
ocr.chooseDesc: Image→text backend for screenshot translate (not MT engines)
ocr.winrtDesc: Built-in, fast, free, no API key
ocr.autoDesc: Try multiple OCR backends in order (slower; unrelated to MT multi-engine)
ocr.youdaoDesc: Free Youdao OCR channel; no separate API key
ocr.tesseractDesc: Browser tesseract.js; downloads language data on first use
ocr.offlineDesc: Models not bundled; point to pot plugin or Paddle extract folder
ocr.pluginDirHint: Rapid needs RapidOcrOnnx.exe + models; Paddle needs PaddleOCR-json.exe. See docs/OCR_OFFLINE.md
ocr.pdfDesc: For document translate. Default pdf-extract; garbled text auto-falls back to page OCR
ocr.pdfHint: pdf-extract for most digital PDFs; auto OCR on garble/crash. ocr needs no extra tools. mineru/marker need pip install.
ocr.sidecarPath: Sidecar CLI path (empty = command on PATH)
ocr.layoutDesc: DocLayout-YOLO model identifies title/body/figure/table/formula regions, improving translation quality for complex-layout PDFs
ocr.layoutEnableHint: Off by default. When enabled, downloads a ~50MB ONNX model on demand; falls back to plain text extraction if unavailable
ocr.layoutNote: Model stored in app_data_dir/models/. Retry on failure; removing re-downloads when re-enabled
ocr.intervalHint: Interval when result card region watch is on (default {default}ms, min {min}ms). Stretches when content is unchanged.

selection.pageDesc: Select text → pop button/auto; hover = dictionary only. Word→dict card, sentence→MT; junk skipped. Default: pop button.
selection.triggerDesc: Word→dict (ECDICT→Youdao); sentence→MT; pop only confirms pending show
selection.popButtonDesc: Show Translate button after select; click to translate (recommended; double-click works)
selection.autoOnSelectDesc: Translate on mouse-up after drag/double-click. Browser/VS Code prefer clipboard; terminals skip Ctrl+C simulation
selection.hotkeyOnlyDesc: Only Ctrl+Shift+Y (configurable) translates; mouse select does not
selection.minDragHint: Hint only; double-click word (0px drag) still picks. Pure click with no selection does not trigger
selection.excludeProcHint: No auto selection/hover in these processes. Electron→clipboard first; terminals→UIA only (never Ctrl+C)
selection.hotkeyNote: Hotkeys are still on the Hotkeys page. In-browser select/hover is the extension. See docs/REFERENCE_SELECTION_UX.md
selection.hoverDesc: Can run with pop-button: dwell for word, drag for button
selection.hoverEnableHint: Lookup after cursor settles (no Alt). A dictionary miss returns the machine translation. Off in terminals. Typing closes card. Shares ECDICT→Youdao with pop button.
selection.hoverCjkHint: Off by default: Chinese hover misfires and triggers slow MT. When on, hover also picks CJK; a dictionary miss still returns the machine translation.
selection.ecdictMissing: Local ECDICT not loaded; hover may be empty for local/auto. Place ecdict.db under dictionaries/ or package resources.
selection.hoverTech: Hover is non-invasive UIA. Reads TextPattern/edit only, not window title Name. Miss skips MT. Hover off in terminals by default.
selection.ocrForceDesc: Not screenshot translate — fallback when selection fails
selection.ocrForceEnable: OCR near cursor when selection is empty
selection.ocrForceHint: Only when: (1) drag/double-click yields no UIA/clipboard text; (2) selection hotkey with no selection. Uses a narrow WinRT strip near the cursor. Full page still uses toolbar OCR screenshot.
selection.ocrModHint: Required for hover-image / empty selection pickup; Shift recommended (Mouse Tooltip Translator).

advanced.extDesc: Connect browser extension for cross-app translation
advanced.apiEnableHint: Local extension can use desktop engines (restart required after change)
advanced.tokenHint2: Paste the same token in extension settings. Do not share the token.
advanced.bridgePortNote: Local port {port}; extension must send the token.
advanced.bridgeOffHint: Extension runs local-only (no desktop engines, local OCR, or glossary sync)
advanced.extInstallHint: After install, the extension tries to connect. Keep the desktop app running with bridge on.
advanced.proxyDesc: Mainly for LLM and similar; Google tries direct first, then proxy
advanced.proxyNote: Most official engines work direct. Google: direct first, then proxy below. Enable proxy for overseas LLM APIs if needed.
advanced.proxyEnableHint: Applies to proxy-capable requests (LLM, Google fallback, etc.)
advanced.cacheDesc: Translated content is cached locally and returned directly on repeat translations
advanced.cacheTtlHint: Entries older than this are auto-evicted on next read. Default 72 hours (3 days). Changes take effect on app restart.
advanced.cacheTtlInvalid: Please enter an integer between 1 and 720
advanced.perfDesc: Tune startup memory and preload behavior (applies on next launch)
advanced.preloadHint: Hidden pages created at startup for instant first use. Each costs ~80-140MB of memory: 0=none, 1=translate card (recommended), 2=+OCR region frame, 3=+selection pop button
advanced.deferWarmupHint: Skip screen capture and OCR model preload at startup for a faster UI; the first OCR use is slightly slower once. Enabled by default.

enginePage.title: Translation engines
enginePage.desc: Text → another language: toggles, keys (non-LLM), global priority. Image→text is under OCR.
enginePage.usageDesc: Product-fixed policy; not changed by the routing radio below
enginePage.usageMainDesc: : enabled engines in parallel, multiple results
enginePage.usageOcrDesc: : ordered fallback, single result; switch engine in-card
enginePage.routingDesc: Main window and OCR are fixed; this only affects other channels
enginePage.aiTranslateDesc: LLM translation prompt, polishing, and glossary tools (model config lives in the LLM page)
enginePage.listHint: Above: enabled engines in priority order (drag to reorder). Below: disabled engines grouped by type. LLM keys are not on this page.
enginePage.enabledDesc: Lower number = higher priority; OCR and routing fall back in this order. Drag the handle to reorder.
enginePage.disabledDesc: Grouped by type in default order; enabling moves it to the priority list above (at the end).
enginePage.noEnabled: No enabled engines (LLM is always kept).
enginePage.sectionLlmDesc: Keys and models on the LLM page; here only priority in the shared list
enginePage.sectionOfficialDesc: Official APIs or stable public services; some need keys to participate
enginePage.sectionWebDesc: No-config web or unofficial endpoints; may break; enable carefully
enginePage.sectionOfflineDesc: Local text MT models (image→text under OCR)
enginePage.routeFallbackDesc: Try engines top-down; first success wins. Selection/Hook; OCR is fixed to this; main window ignores it
enginePage.routePrimaryDesc: Only the first engine; no fallback (non-main channels)
enginePage.routeParallelDesc: Call enabled engines together. Main window already multi-result; no need for this
enginePage.badgeNeedKeyRoute: Key required before routing uses it
enginePage.llmDesc: Large language models with context and custom prompts
enginePage.youdaoDesc: Youdao web free API (unofficial; may change)
enginePage.caiyunDesc: Long text and novels; free quota ~1M chars/month
enginePage.deeplxDesc: Free DeepL-compatible API; optional self-host key
enginePage.tatoebaDesc: Multilingual example pairs; not full-paragraph MT
enginePage.baiduWebDesc: Web API without AppId; may break
enginePage.caiyunWebDesc: Web JWT path; use Caiyun with token for production
enginePage.goAiConfig: Configure keys and model under LLM
enginePage.offlineOcrNote: Screenshot OCR (WinRT/Tesseract/Rapid/Paddle) is under OCR; this section is text MT only.
enginePage.pivotHint: Pivot via English when no direct pair exists

collection.pageDesc: Push saved words to Eudic, Anki, Shanbay, Youdao, or Maimemo (optional).
collection.autoPush: Auto-push to enabled targets when saving to local wordbook
collection.eudicHint: Uses Eudic open API (api.frdic.com). Apply for a token on the Eudic developer portal.
collection.ankiHint: Requires Anki + AnkiConnect on this machine (default 127.0.0.1:8765).
collection.shanbayHint: After logging into Shanbay in the browser, copy auth_token from Cookie. Re-copy when expired. Or export CSV and import in Shanbay.
collection.youdaoHint: Open youdao.com, sign in, find accountinfo in DevTools network, paste the full Cookie below.
collection.maimemoHint: Official API: App → Me → More → Experimental → Open API, copy Token. Notepad ID optional (first push creates one).

hookProfile.tip3: Each profile can have its own source/target languages
